detect_nan_inf_in_forward_pass: detect NaN or Inf values in a PyTorch model's forward pass using NanDetector with forward=True
detect_nan_inf_in_backward_pass: detect NaN or Inf values in a PyTorch model's backward pass using NanDetector with backward=True
use_nan_detector_as_context_manager: use NanDetector as a context manager to auto-detect and log NaN/Inf during model training
reset_nan_detector_flags: reset the NanDetector's has_printed_f and has_printed_b flags using the reset method
close_nan_detector_hooks: close and remove all forward and backward hooks registered by NanDetector using the close method
